snippet.description:
Learn curve tracing of polar curves and how to find rectilinear and circular asymptotes of polar curves in differential calculus for B.Sc. Maths students.

Learn curve tracing of polar curves and how to find rectilinear and circular asymptotes of polar curves in differential calculus for B.Sc. Maths students.

Hello students, welcome back to Fractal Frontier Maths! Is lecture mein hum seekhenge Curve Tracing of Polar Curves aur polar curves ke asymptotes nikalne ka complete step-by-step method. Agar aap B.Sc. Mathematics ya engineering calculus ki taiyari kar rahe hain, toh yeh concept aapke exam ke liye bohot important hai.

📌 Topics Covered in This Video:
Introduction to Polar Coordinates $(r, \theta)$ vs Cartesian Coordinates
Symmetry rules for Polar Curves (Initial line, $\theta = \alpha/2$, Pole)
Curve passing through Pole & finding tangent at Pole
Special points calculation using standard angles
Region of existence & Loops condition ($\sin n\theta$, $\cos n\theta$)
Asymptotes of Polar Curves:
Rectilinear Asymptotes (सरल रेखीय अनंत स्पर्शी)
Circular Asymptotes (वृत्ताकार अनंत स्पर्शी)
Solved Examples with graphical visualization

06:45 - Condition for Curve Passing Through Pole & Tangent at Pole
08:20 - Overview of Asymptotes of Polar Curves
09:20 - Finding Special Points Using Standard Angles
11:15 - Region of Existence & Periodic Functions
13:35 - Conditions for Loops in Polar Curves
18:15 - Rectilinear Asymptotes: Formula & Theory
21:15 - Circular Asymptotes: Formula & Theory
23:25 - Example 1: Finding Rectilinear Asymptotes
30:25 - Graphical Visualization of Example 1 (Desmos)
31:38 - Example 2: Rectilinear & Circular Asymptotes
37:40 - Graphical Visualization of Example 2 (Desmos)
40:30 - Summary & Conclusion

👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig

Happy Learning! 📐✨
